title: Property wrappers for clamped values
summary: Centralize range validation in a property wrapper that clamps both initial values and later assignments.
triggers: many properties need the same validation on initialization and assignment
prompts: Keep a volume level between zero and one hundred using a reusable wrapper.
invariant: The stored value always lies inside the configured closed range.
mantra: Validate at initialization and on every write.
pitfalls: Clamping only in the setter would leave an invalid initial value possible.
wrappedValue is the property-wrapper interface used by the wrapped property.
